set.body: Goal: turn SceneConformance from a shared fixture object into a reusable renderer conformance contract that future SVG, Canvas, Java2D, and JavaFX backends can run. Acceptance: conformance cases are grouped by primitive/layout/guide/compiled-plot behavior; backend modules can assert deterministic rendering without encoding plot semantics; SVG adopts the harness; graphics and graphics-svg JVM/JS tests pass.
set.title: Graphics: build reusable renderer conformance harness
